sections.changelog:
Added

  • Initial release. Calculator library for fireplaces, stoves, chimneys, barbecues, fireboxes and flues, rendered via the `[mvweb_fcalc id="..."]` shortcode.
  • Six calculator hubs: Heating and power, Chimneys and draft, Masonry and materials, Foundations and pads, Fuel and economics, Safety and layout.
  • 36 bundled calculators.
  • Appearance settings under MVweb Hub → Fireplace Calc: 11 frontend theme presets, border, corner rounding, accent color and submit button variant.
  • Full English and Russian (ru_RU) localization.
